Source Code Snippet: PluginInterfaceRef& operator=(PluginInterfaceRef&& other) { if (this != &other) { _interface = other._interface; other._interface = nullptr; } return *this; }
Issue Description: Move-assignment overwrites _interface without releasing existing ownership and does not move _service causing stale state and potential leaked reference
Suggested Fix: Release current resource and move both _interface and _service while nulling moved-from object

Issue Description: The strdup result is used without checking for allocation failure which can pass a null pointer to telemetry API under memory pressure
Suggested Fix: Guard strdup result before use and return/log when allocation fails
